# Method: two enumeration passes of different nature, cross-checked against each other.
#   (a) MCP Serena LSP references -- mcp__serena__find_referencing_symbols on
#       ::getFormulaForLevel (7 calls total: 1 failed lookup on the promoted property's synthetic
#       name path, 6 successful) and mcp__serena__find_implementations on MetricRepositoryInterface
#       (1 call). LSP resolves method-call targets through variables and dynamic arguments (e.g. it
#       same way as literal ->all(SymbolType::Class_)), and it is immune to the property/property-name
#       collision described below. It does NOT resolve promoted-constructor-property reads/writes as
#       queries both failed), so property-level read/write enumeration fell entirely to grep.
#   (b) git grep -P (never -E: -E silently drops \b and \s in this git version) for ->all(, for
#       SymbolType::Method / ::Function_ co-occurrence, for ->levels / levels: writes, for mapLevel,
#       and for SymbolType usage across src/Reporting. Grep is textual: it caught two classes Serena's
#       targeted queries would have missed by construction -- the YAML-heredoc "levels: [namespace]"
#       fixture lines (not a PHP symbol at all) and the false-positive collision between
#       which share the property name "levels" and were manually disambiguated below by owning class
#       (import + receiver-variable naming: "$declaration->levels" is always ChannelDeclaration in this
#       readers is always the target property). Cross-check: Serena's 36-file ->all(SymbolType) call-site
#       set and grep's SymbolType::-literal + 4 known-dynamic-var set agree exactly (59 real call sites
#       after subtracting 4 docblock-comment lines that quote the call in prose, not code).
# Channels this method does NOT see (named per CLAUDE.md instruction, not silently assumed covered):
#   - string-identifier / YAML-key references: covered for the one channel that matters here (mapLevel's
#     'levels' YAML key, and its 'class'/'namespace'/'project' formula-key sibling), not swept generally.
#   - reflection (ReflectionProperty/ReflectionClass) reads of ->levels or ->all: NOT covered -- neither
#     pass detects reflection-mediated access; none is known to exist for these two members, but that is
#     an absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
#   - PHPDoc-only generics (@param list<SymbolType> in a signature with no runtime SymbolType symbol):
#     covered only where grep's SymbolType text pattern also matched the docblock line; a generic typed
#     purely via a phpstan-only alias with no literal "SymbolType" token would be missed. None found.
#   - DI/YAML container configuration referencing these classes by string service id: NOT swept; neither
#     class is autowired by a role scan per CLAUDE.md Rule 7, so this is believed low-risk, not verified.
#   - dynamic ->all($var) / ->{$prop} calls where $var's origin could not be traced to a literal or a
#     grep-matched pattern: the 4 dynamic call sites found (HealthSummaryBuilder, BoundaryExplanationService,
#     MetricsJsonFormatter, AnalysisPipelineIntegrationTest) were traced by hand to their SymbolType-typed
#     origin; a fifth dynamic site reachable only through a deeper call chain would not surface from a
#     single-hop grep and was not searched for beyond Serena's reference graph.
#   - test doubles / mocks built with PHPUnit's createMock() or fixture factories that never mention
#     "SymbolType" or "levels" as literal tokens (e.g. a stub returning a pre-baked array): NOT covered
#     by text search; Serena's find_implementations (LSP-based, not text-based) is exhaustive for actual
#     `implements MetricRepositoryInterface` declarations and found the 2 listed under kind=implementation.
#   - external/out-of-repo consumers (no external users per CLAUDE.md Backward Compatibility Policy):
#     out of scope, matches project policy.

column4: private static levels(array $config, array $defaults): reads $config['levels'] (a list<string> from YAML), array_map's each entry through mapLevel(...); falls back to $defaults (a list<SymbolType>) when the key is absent or not an array

private static mapLevel(string $level): SymbolType -- the actual domain gate. Accepts a string, parses it via SymbolLevel::tryFrom($level) FIRST (so the accepted string domain is exactly SymbolLevel's 5 case values: callable/class/file/namespace/project), throws ComputedMetricConfigurationException('Invalid computed metric level: "%s"') for anything else (typos, unknown words). Of the 5 SymbolLevel values, only Class_/Namespace_/Project map to a SymbolType and are accepted; Callable and File are recognised as real level words but explicitly rejected with 'is not supported; computed metrics report at "class", "namespace" or "project" only' -- a narrower, capability-specific domain layered on top of the shared vocabulary, not a second copy of it
